messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HOSTED/GPU POOL ALERT - hosted/gpu-us-east queue length rising rapidly, alloc=97%. p95 latency up ~3.1x, p99 ~5.5x. Autoscaler errors: "quota_limit" and "provisioner_timeout". Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity

nora (oncall): Ack. Im starting triage. Pulling autoscaler + provisioner traces now.

devin (serving): Noticing multiple high-fanout calls from partner-sync (mobile-campaigns) pushing many parallel short requests -> lots of small KV fills and cache misses. 9.8k RPS sustained over 8m. Median seq ~90 but tail has many >600.

ryan (sre): Autoscaler logs show repeated 503/429 from cloud quotas: "GPU_QUOTA_EXCEEDED". Provisioner is queuing create requests and then timing out on allocation.

nora (oncall): Immediate mitigations: 1) Put a temporary ingress circuit-breaker for best-effort routes. 2) Shift non-critical customers to quantized variantes. 3) Shorten long timeouts to avoid inflight hogs.

devin (serving): I can hot-swap a quantized replica and reroute a slice of traffic. Plan: 75/25 split to quant-8bit for partner-sync, enable aggressive prefix caching and enable small-request CPU fallback for requests <=64 tokens.

ops (infrabot): Provisioner snapshot:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:11Z ERROR provisioner: create_node failed: GPU_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
2026-03-17T03:12:13Z WARN  provisioner: retrying create in backoff (attempt=4)
2026-03-17T03:12:29Z ERROR provisioner: allocate timed out after 18s
```

ryan (sre): Cloud ticket opened (#CS-90012). Support responded: manual review required for quota bump, ETA unknown (hours). We must assume mitigation window ~1-4h.

nora (oncall): Executing ingress rule now. Applying short leaky-bucket for non-enterprise sources and set max_input_tokens=512 for those routes.

devin (serving): Routing command executed:
```
redwood route modify --src partner-sync --split 75,25 --variants main,main-quant-8bit
redwood route set-policy --src partner-sync --policy "max_tokens:512, tier:best-effort, cpu_fallback:true"
```

maya (support): Impacted customers flagged: AcmePay (timeouts), Lexicon.ai (degraded p99), partner-sync partners reporting 504 spikes. Support notified and posting status updates.

nora (oncall): Also enabling a short-lived global circuit-breaker for tail-heavy contexts: if seq_length > 800 -> reject with 413 for non-enterprise.

devin (serving): Rolling adaptive-batching tweak to reduce per-token overhead on remaining GPU workers (increase batch window by 20ms for smaller fairness). Rolling in 90s. Expected token cost down ~30%.

ops (infrabot): Additional logs:
```
2026-03-17T03:18:04Z INFO autoscaler: scale_up_attempt enqueued=12
2026-03-17T03:18:12Z ERROR cloudapi: quota.limit - response 429
```

ryan (sre): We also found a noisy tenant creating many parallel low-latency requests. Recommend immediate per-tenant concurrency cap (50 concurrent) until quota is resolved.

nora (oncall): Implemented gateway patch:
```
PATCH /gateway/config
- routes[partner-sync].concurrency_limit = 50
- routes[*].timeout.best_effort = 7s
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Routing & throttle changes applied. Telemetry: queue depth stabilized within 3m, p95 improved ~35%. p99 still elevated from long-context requests.

devin (serving): Remaining p99 contributors are a mix of seq>800 and a handful of enterprise pipelines we couldn't throttle. Suggest next steps: 1) ask enterprise teams for voluntary backpressure, 2) schedule postmortem to add request-level tagging to find offending endpoints.

maya (support): Notifying impacted enterprise contacts and suggesting workaround: use quantized variant or reduce context length. Sending formal update now.

nora (oncall): Handoff checklist for next oncall: - keep the ingress caps in place until cloud quota confirmed - monitor hosted/gpu-us-east.queue and p99 metric for 30m rolling - escalate cloud ticket after 2h if no progress - rollback split once p99 < 2x baseline for 20m. Runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity, cloud ticket CS-90012, support doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/8251234567

eli (oncall-morning): Ack, will pick up in ~6h. Leave me the telemetry query and the list of tenants we throttled?

nora (oncall): Will attach graphs and tenant list to the incident doc. Quick numbers:
```
baseline p95: 110ms -> peaked 360ms
baseline p99: 340ms -> peaked 1.9s
queue depth baseline: 8 -> peaked 512
```

devin (serving): Action item: add tenant-level request histograms for next-day postmortem and consider preemptive per-tenant concurrency quotas in control plane.

maya (support): Customers informed. Creating postmortem ticket and including SLA impact notes.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (active mitigations in place). Channel will remain open for updates and handoff notes. :memo:
